subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian state has highest production from Viticulture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The cultivation and harvesting of grapes are called viticulture.
 
• Viticulture is the speciality of the Mediterranian region.
 
• The best quality wines in the world with distinctive flavours are produced from this region such as Port wine is famous in Portugal, Sherry in Southern Spain, etc. 
 
• **In India, Maharashtra state has the highest production of Viticulture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
Terminology

 
 
 
Explanation

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Horticulture

 
 
 
The branch of plant agriculture deals with garden crops, generally fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.

 
 
 

 
 
Sericulture

 
 
 
 Commercial rearing of silkworms for the production of silk.

 
 
 

 
 
Pisciculture

 
 
 
 The rearing and controlled breeding of fishes.
